title: melicope philippinensis
intro: Melicope philippinensis, commonly known as Philippine mountain garcinia, is a plant species belonging to the Rutaceae family, native to the Philippines. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Melicope philippinensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and limonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
